speaker: Old Kings' Cairn
description: An Old Kings' cairn on the ridge eyrie's spire (plan M6-M9 §5.4: poi.ridge_eyrie, a sealed place out of reach below stage 6; P36): reading it once gives one attribute point (once-flag reward.cairn.ridge_eyrie).

nodes.text: A cairn on the spire's top, where only the tallest can reach. 'The kings watched the road from here, and the road never saw them.'

choices.text: [Lay a hand on the stones] (+1 attribute point)

nodes.text: An Old Kings' cairn. Its strength is already in you.
